mentions.name: Strata
mentions.description: A log analyzer built on a native C++ engine with a Flutter UI that opens 50GB log files in 8 seconds without excessive RAM usage and maintains 60fps scrolling. Runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS, and includes DevOps/SRE features such as live SSH tailing, JSON analysis and formatting, and context-aware search with regex, text, and JSON-field queries. Currently in beta with about 70% of the functionality done.
mentions.problem: Existing log analysis tools choke on huge log files, eating RAM and becoming unusable.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a Log analyzer, something that doesn't choke on huge files. I ended up building something that can open a 50GB log file in 8 seconds and not eat your RAM, while maintaining 60fps when scrolling.
